english: A man is standing in front of the door.
target: Ein Mann steht vor der Tür.

english: She is standing at the window.
She does not turn on a light.
The man waits for a long time.

hint: The first part stays in second position; weg goes to the end.

english: Something is lying on the ground.
Clara comes out of the house.
But Clara lives at number nineteen.
target: Aber Clara wohnt in Nummer neunzehn.

english: A chair is standing in the room.
A letter is lying on the chair.
target: Auf dem Stuhl liegt ein Brief.

english: Someone else is in the house.
A man comes through the door.
target: Ein Mann kommt durch die Tür.

english: And Emil likes to investigate strange cases.
target: Und Emil sucht gern seltsame Fälle.
